summary: Exact prior error-79 artifact contained NXSB-only structural evidence. Added evidence-only APSB parser to Integration evidence, exposing FSIndex, feature masks, meta-crypto bytes, tree types/OIDs, revert metadata, counts, UUID, fs flags and a raw 0x400-byte APSB prefix for source/rebuilt comparison. No APFS writer semantics changed. Exact Windows E2E for this target commit is in progress.
